findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "slim_report" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Paid, read-only: per-tool token report + trim advice. $0.001 USDC via x402, or 1 unit with a key." → after: "Paid, read-only: per-tool token report + trim advice. $0.005 USDC via x402, or 1 unit with a key."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
